# Re-search for 'trash can' items with max_price=30 and filter for 'trash can'/'trash bin'/'waste bin' in name/description
max_price=30.0
query='trash can'
page_limit=20
page_index=0
products=[]

while True:
    res=apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, max_price=max_price, sort_by='-rating', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(res) if res else 0)
    if not res:
        break
    products.extend(res)
    if len(res)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

print('total_products', len(products))

# filter likely trash can / bin (not trash bags)
keywords=['trash can','trash bin','waste bin','wastebasket','garbage can','trash receptacle']
exclude=['trash bag','trash bags','drawstring','compostable bag','garbage bag']

candidates=[]
for p in products:
    text=((p.get('name') or '')+' '+(p.get('description') or '')).lower()
    if any(k in text for k in keywords) and not any(e in text for e in exclude):
        if p.get('price',0)<=max_price and p.get('inventory_quantity',0)>=1:
            candidates.append(p)

print('candidates_count', len(candidates))
# sort by rating desc, num_reviews desc, price asc, delivery_days asc
candidates_sorted=sorted(candidates, key=lambda p:(-p.get('rating',0), -p.get('num_product_reviews',0), p.get('price',0), p.get('delivery_days',1e9), -p.get('inventory_quantity',0)))
for p in candidates_sorted[:10]:
    print({'product_id':p['product_id'],'name':p['name'],'rating':p['rating'],'num_reviews':p.get('num_product_reviews'),'price':p['price'],'delivery_days':p.get('delivery_days'),'inv':p.get('inventory_quantity'), 'product_type':p.get('product_type')})

best=candidates_sorted[0] if candidates_sorted else None
print('best_candidate:', best)

from datetime import datetime

# Reuse existing variables if present
if 'amz_token' not in globals():
    # login only if needed
    pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    amz_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
    amz_username = 'mi.burch@gmail.com'
    amz_login = apis.amazon.login(username=amz_username, password=amz_pw)
    amz_token = amz_login['access_token']

now = datetime.now()
print('now:', now.isoformat())

# Reuse addresses/payment_cards if present
if 'addresses' not in globals():
    addresses = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=amz_token)
if 'payment_cards' not in globals():
    payment_cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amz_token)

work_addr = None
for a in addresses:
    if a.get('name')=='Work':
        work_addr = a
        break
print('work_address_selected:', work_addr)

# pick first non-expired payment card
valid_cards=[]
for c in payment_cards:
    exp_year = int(c.get('expiry_year'))
    exp_month = int(c.get('expiry_month'))
    # consider card valid through end of expiry_month
    is_valid = (exp_year > now.year) or (exp_year == now.year and exp_month >= now.month)
    if is_valid:
